editorial: The Deadly Little Mermaid plunges into a chilling blend of folk horror and psychological suspense, crafting an atmosphere that is thick, claustrophobic, and utterly unsettling. This film masterfully uses the coastal setting to elevate the dread, turning a beautiful recovery story into a deeply disturbing descent into secrets. The pacing is relentless, delivering a genuinely terrifying final act that will keep you guessing until the credits roll.
